_note: Captured sessions only — sessions that merged, plus sessions that ended cleanly enough for the SessionEnd capture to fire. Reclaimed containers and crashes are invisible here, so these are SAMPLE counts, not a census of all work. The check counts are narrower still: they are what a session SAW. A CI run counts when the session pulled its job log in — which is what "the agent was in the loop on it" means — and a nightly or post-merge run nobody looked at does not, because nothing was corrected. CI can only see a run that PRINTED something, so its share is carried separately as ciRuns/ciFailures. Every check number is a floor on activations, never an over-count. The `tasks` rows are HISTORICAL: they came from the retired slot scheduler's run records rather than from a captured session, and nothing writes that record any more, so they stop where that mechanism did and are not comparable to a later period.
